content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering an issue with the message text box in my current project. The box remains active even when there is no input signal. Can someone explain why this is happening? I've attached an image for reference. Thank you!

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. The message text box is configured to need acknowledgment. This setting keeps the message active until the input signal goes low and the message is acknowledged using the OK button or the Enter button on the operator device.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is confused about the active state of a message text box when no input signal is present. Another user explains that the box remains active because it requires manual acknowledgment and the signal must be cleared before it deactivates, highlighting a common misunderstanding about how message acknowledgment works in this product.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the message text box to only be active when there is an input signal and to turn off automatically when no signal is present.
